items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Well, the Reverend and I put together the date for that, and we paid for the date to record the band.

ctx.x: Well, the Reverend and I put together the date for that, and we paid for the date to record the band. But it came out on Zim Records. So he paid us about two thousand dollars to put it out -- which was all right. I mean, it was going to come out anyway, but it came out, and didn't raise no hell anyway. But it did sound good. Yeah, that one was really nice. I'll play it for you some time, if you haven't heard it.
